lines.text: Many learners say: Actually, I live in this city.
Better: Currently, I live in this city.

data.wrong: Actually, I live in this city.
data.right: Currently, I live in this city.

native.caption: Cuidado com este erro comum! 😬 Muita gente diz “Actually, I live in this city.” O certo é “Currently, I live in this city.” Cuidado: é um falso cognato clássico. Ouça a Ama e repita! Treine mais no app Lexkite.

en.tip: “Actually” means “in fact”. For “these days”, use “currently” or “nowadays”.
en.caption: Watch out for this common mistake! Many people say “Actually, I live in this city.” The right way is “Currently, I live in this city.” Careful: it is a classic false friend. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
